Docs Get started
Productivity & security

The Teampass browser extension

Autofill and capture for Chrome, Firefox and Edge, talking only to your own Teampass instance. It is the paid part of the project — and what keeps the server free.

See pricing Extension documentation
The arrangement

Teampass stays open-source. The extension goes further.

The server remains free, open-source and self-hosted — always. The extension is a professional add-on for people who live in the browser all day.

Productivity

Fill credentials in the tab you are already in. No window switching, no clipboard.

Security

Domain matching means credentials do not offer themselves on a lookalike phishing page.

Capture

New sign-ups get saved into the right folder instead of a note somewhere.

Sovereignty

Your data never transits our servers. It moves between your browser and your instance.

Free trial

Thirty days, whole team, no card

Every new instance gets a full month of the extension for every user. Long enough to find out whether autofill actually changes your team's habits — which is the only question that matters.

How to activate

Available for Chrome, Firefox and Edge. Install it from your browser's store, then point it at your own Teampass instance.

Pricing

Buy capacity, manage your own access

Simple, predictable, annual. No per-seat micro-management.

Pack Capacity Annual price Suited to
Starter Pack 3 users €49 Freelancers, solo consultants and two-person technical shops.
Team Pack 10 users €150 Small IT agencies, startups and specialised technical squads.
Business Pack 25 users €350 SMEs and growing departments that live in the browser all day.
Premium Pack 50 users €600 Larger IT departments focused on password hygiene at scale.

Prices exclude taxes. Includes updates and email support. Need something larger or a site licence? Ask for a quote.

The Teampass server is free and open-source, and always will be. The browser extension is what funds continued development.
Activation

Getting the trial running

  1. Update your instance

    Install or upgrade to Teampass v3, then open Settings > Extension in the administration area.

  2. Install the extension

    From the Chrome, Firefox or Edge store.

  3. Send us two values

    Email nils@teampass.net with the FQDN of your instance and its instance token, both shown in that settings screen.

Where to find those values, and every configuration option, is covered in the extension documentation.

Questions

Straight answers

What happens after the free trial?

The extension stops autofilling. Everything stays fully accessible through the Teampass web interface — nothing is lost, nothing is locked.

How are users counted?

By the number of unique accounts that used the browser extension during the month. People who only use the web interface do not count against your pack.

Why doesn't it autofill on every site?

Some sites use non-standard forms, single-page frameworks or fields injected after load, which cannot be detected reliably. On those, autofill and capture can be triggered manually from the extension popup.

Can we move up a pack during the year?

Yes. What you have already paid is deducted pro-rata.

Does the extension see my browsing?

It matches the current domain against your stored items so it knows what to offer. It does not collect browsing history, and nothing is sent to us — see the privacy policy.

Why is it paid when the server is free?

Maintaining an extension across three browsers is continuous work — three review processes and three sets of breaking changes every year. Charging for it funds the open-source server instead of paywalling the server’s own features.

Privacy policy — the extension does not collect browsing data, and your credentials stay on your own server.

Try it for a month.

Every new instance gets thirty days across the whole team, with no card and no commitment.
